purpose: Resolve the P42 KeNADA follow-up into a reproducible source-access and geography-precision decision for the first survey small-area-estimation pilot.

sources.title: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey 2022
sources.access_notes: KeNADA declares the anonymized dataset a Public Use Dataset for statistical/scientific research. Its conditions prohibit redistribution and re-identification. Raw microdata must therefore never be committed to this public repository.

sampling_and_geography.design_domain: national, rural/urban and some county estimates
sampling_and_geography.frame: 2019 KPHC Kenya Household Master Sample Frame; sampled EAs were developed into georeferenced clusters

geospatial_status.confidentiality_geometry: cluster coordinates are displaced for confidentiality
geospatial_status.approved_use: geostatistical/small-area modelling with displacement-aware covariate extraction and population-weighted prediction aggregation

sources.p42_decision: preferred national microdata family for the first SAE pilot once recode and DHS geographic data are held outside the repository under their access conditions

sources.title: Kenya Population and Housing Census 2019
sources.geography_status: Public catalog metadata states whole-country coverage and household/individual units but does not establish a redistributable ward/constituency identifier or public microdata geography precise enough for exact Local-54 aggregation.
sources.p42_decision: do_not_treat_as_unlocked_local_census_microdata until file-level geographic variables and access rights are verified

sources.title: County-level SMART surveys
sources.geography_status: Some cataloged SMART survey files expose ward-name fields and/or GPS latitude/longitude variables.
sources.limitations: County-specific samples are not a national substitute for KDHS and cannot be promoted to nationwide Local-54 values without survey-design and comparability checks.
sources.p42_decision: candidate external validation/calibration evidence for covered counties, never automatic national training data

repository_artifacts_allowed: source metadata and access decision records
file hashes and non-sensitive schema manifests
aggregated cluster sufficient statistics after disclosure review
constituency/ward aggregate predictions with uncertainty after P42 validation
prohibited: attempting to reverse displacement or re-identify respondents
treating displaced DHS cluster coordinates as exact household or ward locations
redistributing KNBS/DHS raw microdata through this repository
